map_elements.note: A new silhouette, and specifically NOT a flat pad: the player has been taught on this same map that a flat 3 m hex means stand-here-and-hold-E, so a flat enemy gate would say that and mean the opposite — §4.12 forbids decoration reading as a control. Vertical: 4.5 m ring/arch on a 0.3 m plinth, 3 m clear opening facing ±Z, ≤2,500 tris / ≤12 parts. _active carries an emissive MASK part named warp_membrane for the code to pulse.
Map-morph states; same footprint, swap on event.

maps.note: 20 m dry-autumn-grass tile in four variants, ≤900 tris / ≤4 parts each, one shared 2048² set; relief ≤0.15 m and exactly 0 within 2 m of every edge. 128 instanced placements, so the tile carries no road, fence or grass tuft — tufts are the scatter clump (≤400/4, cap now 140).

Linear modules: asphalt run +X repeat 4.0 width 6.0 top y 0.05 (≤200/2); gravel width 4.0 top y 0.04 (≤150/1); 30° arc, origin at the centre of curvature, radius 12 (≤200/1). Vehicle handling reads the road CENTRE LINES, so the art must sit on the line. Note that the network in the brief is four disconnected fragments — the barn drive stops 19 m short of the barn and dies 8 m off the county road, the county road ends in open field, the south road starts and stops 100 m inside each boundary, and the circular drive sat 22 m from the house it serves. Every authored vertex is kept and the gaps closed by extension, so the delivered network is one connected graph reaching all four buildings; three bends were added to keep carriageway out of the Vehickle and Grnmchn footprints. Interior bends are filleted — two runs butting at a vertex leave a notch on the outside of the turn as wide as the turn is sharp.

~780 placements now, ~1,500 dressed — the most instanced thing on the map. Closed-canopy second-growth hardwood: trunks run bare and near-vertical for more than half their height and the crowns start where they reach the light, which is what the street views show and what an open-grown specimen tree is not. LOD0 ≤600 tris and EXACTLY 2 parts (_trunk, _canopy) because culling acts on a multimesh's whole box; LOD1 ≤40 tris, 1 part, sized off a measured build of LOD0 so the 90 m swap does not change the outline. Shared 1024² leaf atlas, alphaMode MASK; lodSwitch 90.

Shell + roof per building (the roof is stood on, so it carries its own collider). All four are BRICK — red-brown on the main house and the shed, browner on the ranch, buff on the south house — with stucco gable fields above the eaves, which is the two-tone that gives these rooflines their read. Barn 30×21 eaves 6.0; three houses 19×28 / 34×26 / 24×30, eaves 3.4. Each roof carries ONE 6×6 m flat at the stated height, placed at the ladder head (a corner on all four), with the rest a real 28° gabled roof split into bays across X — three parallel gables ridging at 6.4 m on the main house. The contract asks for a flat AREA, not a flat roof, and allows pitched slopes to 30°; reading it the other way is what made the first pass look like four sheds with lids. Projecting cross-gabled entry bays with brick arches on the three houses, trimmed back to 0.9–1.8 m where §4.8 lane clearance needs it. Walls 0.3 thick, interior floor top y 0.15, clear height ≥3.0, door OPENINGS only (the shed's second bay is a closed white leaf, not an opening), windows in the texture. ≤6,000/12 per shell, ≤1,500/3 per roof.
Placed by the level file rather than baked into the shells, so rooms arrange around the teleport pads and sockets. ≤1,500 tris, ≤8 parts each.

Drawn UPWARD, not dug — the ground is one flat slab: an ELLIPTICAL basin (36 × 30, long axis north-east, measured off the aerial rather than assumed round), riprap bank ring r 15–18 rising to 0.5 m, an opaque dark water ring at y 0.15, and a big bare island of r 9.6 filling most of the middle. The pond on this property reads as a ring of water round an island, not as a lake. ≤2,500 tris, 3 parts named pond_bank / pond_water / pond_island, no collision. Dock optional.

700 m dome, overcast late-autumn afternoon, sun 24° elevation / 220° azimuth. Treeline silhouette baked into the horizon band so the belt meets the sky. Bake 2048×1024 — half the existing two, which are 9 MB each for no gain here.

Fence is a linear module (run +X, repeat 4.0, width 0.2); bales and leaf piles instance. The wrecked pickup is DRESSING, no rig. Nothing here may sit within 3 m of a route, socket, pad, spawn, armory or hero station — the code refuses and logs those placements.

vehicles.note: Rear-engined saloon, 2 seats abreast, hull 1.55×1.5×4.1, wheel r 0.29, steer_wheel, eye 1.15. Farm-kept, faded paint, one dented wing.
Utility vehicle, hull 1.5×1.85×2.9, wheel r 0.31, bench seat, roll cage, open bed with strapped tarp, light bar, eye 1.0. Lives in the barn and is driven through its 5×4 door.

Motorised drift trike, hull 0.9×0.9×1.9. Front wheel_0 r 0.25 on a fork that is also the steering node; rear wheel_1/_2 r ~0.13 in plastic drift sleeves. Steers by TWO LEVERS (steer_lever_l/_r pivoting about Y at the fork), not a wheel — which is why it spins on the spot. Eye 0.75, the lowest on the map. Green.
Sport quad, hull 1.16×1.13×1.85, wheel r 0.28, steer_bars, saddle eye 1.05. Fastest thing on the map at 22 m/s.

Two poses through the existing HAND_POSES mechanism, six sets each. wheel: ten-and-two on a 0.38 m rim, origin at the hub, viewmodel frame. bars: grips 0.7 m apart, used by the quad and the trike's levers. Not blocking; wheel first if only one is affordable.
